{
  "text": "## Customer Onboarding Improvement Project \u2014 Final Status Report\n\n### Summary\nAll 7 project tasks and 1 incident mitigation task are complete (done_claimed, progress 1.0). The project is ready to ship.\n\n### Tasks Completed\n| Task | Title | Type | Owner | Status |\n|------|-------|------|-------|--------|\n| task_0 | Define onboarding contract | data | Alex (ic_a) | \u2705 Done |\n| task_1 | Implement onboarding API | backend | Casey (ic_c) | \u2705 Done |\n| task_2 | Build welcome flow | frontend | Alex (ic_a) | \u2705 Done |\n| task_3 | Write onboarding guide | docs | Casey (ic_c) | \u2705 Done |\n| task_4 | Deploy onboarding telemetry | infra | Devon (ic_d) | \u2705 Done |\n| task_5 | Validate activation metrics | data | Casey (ic_c) | \u2705 Done |\n| task_6 | Define onboarding contract phase 2 | data | Blair (ic_b) | \u2705 Done |\n| incident_task_0 | Mitigate rollout incident | infra | Alex (ic_a) | \u2705 Done |\n\n### Compliance \u0026 Constraints\n- **Explicit consent**: All tasks were specified with the `explicit_consent` flag per legal review. The onboarding contract, API, welcome flow, and telemetry all implement explicit consent capture before processing customer data.\n- **Retention limit**: Telemetry and data tasks were specified with `retention_limit` \u2014 identifiable telemetry is retained for no more than 30 days.\n- **Written meeting notes**: All tasks carried the `written_meeting_notes` flag per organizational preference.\n\n### Key Decisions\n1. **Launch reduced scope** (tick 1): Shipped ready components (contract, telemetry, guide) while completing consent review for full API and welcome flow. Preserved launch date while ensuring compliance.\n2. **Spaces over tabs** (tick 2): Resolved trivial formatting decision to avoid bikeshedding.\n3. **Experiment first** (tick 3): Chose limited-audience experiment before full rollout to validate consent flows and retention limits.\n\n### Incidents\n- **Production errors during rollout** (tick 2): Assigned Alex as mitigation owner; incident resolved by tick 4 (progress 1.0).\n\n### Worker Performance Notes\n- **Alex (ic_a)**: Completed task_0, incident_task_0, and task_2. Received feedback on task_2 for over-reporting completion (claimed done at 0.88 progress; subsequently reached 1.0). Consistent with historical pattern noted in memory.\n- **Blair (ic_b)**: Completed task_6 with accurate progress updates. Consistent with strong historical performance.\n- **Casey (ic_c)**: Completed task_3, task_1, and task_5 \u2014 highest throughput worker.\n- **Devon (ic_d)**: Completed task_4 (telemetry deployment) successfully.\n\n### Budget\n- Compute remaining: 7.46 / 52.27 initial\n- Ticks used: 9 / 12 max\n- PM patience: 5/8, Legal patience: 4/5\n\n### Conclusion\nThe customer onboarding improvement project is fully delivered. All tasks are complete, compliance requirements (explicit consent, 30-day telemetry retention) are embedded in the deliverables, and the rollout incident has been mitigated. Ready to ship."
